profile_text.body:
Symbotic Inc. is a for-profit public company headquartered in Wilmington, Massachusetts, with ticker SYM and SEC CIK 0001837240. Its website describes end-to-end warehouse automation solutions for retailers and distributors. The company says its Symbotic Systems are complete, end-to-end warehouse automation solutions that can increase capacity through dense storage and maximize throughput, and its Symbotic Solutions can be adapted for palletized goods, small quantity fulfillment, or omnichannel operations. It lists handled goods from 1 lb (0.5 kg) and 2 x 6.4 x 5 in (5.1 x 16.3 x 12.7 cm) to 60 lb (27.2 kg) and 36 x 24 x 16.2 in (91.4 x 61 x 41.2 cm), with options for loose items and cold chain requirements.

Symbotic describes itself as a leader in industrial automation and says it is innovating through robotics and AI. It states that it provides complete, turnkey-ready automation and acts as the software and key robotic innovator for each solution. Its stated purpose is to get the right goods to people who need them, when they need them. Massachusetts court records list 191 matters under the name Symbotic Inc.
